title: Add sqlx/auth dependencies and initial migration
acceptance: Migration file exists under db/migrations
api crate includes sqlx, uuid, time, argon2, async-trait
notes: Verify against spec before extending schema.

title: Add AppState and router state wiring
acceptance: Router accepts PgPool state
Health test does not require a live DB connection
notes: Health uses a lazy pool because /healthz does not touch DB.

title: Review auth domain types and error mapping against spec
acceptance: ApiError status codes and JSON bodies match design spec
User, Role, ApiToken, and Scope match schema
notes: ScopeRequired now returns structured scope details; error mapping matches the Plan 2 spec review.

title: Review bearer auth extractor and scope guard
acceptance: Invalid tokens return 401
Missing scopes return 403
last_used_at update behavior is intentional and documented
notes: Token parser handles underscores in secrets; unknown DB roles no longer silently map to user; implementation compiles without sqlx online macros.

title: Review idempotency middleware semantics
acceptance: Same key and same request returns stored response
Same key and different request returns 409
Middleware state wiring works with Axum 0.8
notes: Replay verifies the bearer token secret before returning stored responses; successful responses are persisted before returning.

title: Make SQL lint quiet and Postgres-specific
acceptance: make check emits no sqlfluff dialect warning
sqlfluff uses postgres dialect
notes: .sqlfluff sets postgres dialect and current migration passes sqlfluff lint.

title: Decide DB integration test contract
acceptance: Docs clarify whether make check skips DB tests or requires make db-up
CI/pre-commit behavior is deterministic
notes: make check skips DB-backed auth tests unless AME_RUN_DB_TESTS=1; make test-db is the explicit DB integration path after make db-up.

title: Wire Scope enum through auth extractor and RequireScope
acceptance: Scope enum used in AuthenticatedUser and RequireScope (not raw strings)
Unknown DB scope strings return ApiError instead of silently passing
Unit tests cover Scope parsing
Integration test still passes
notes: Scope::as_str (const fn), FromStr, Display, UnknownScope added; AuthenticatedUser.token_scopes is Vec<Scope>; ScopeConstraint::SCOPE is now Scope; 3 unit tests in domain/user.rs cover roundtrip/unknown/Display; clippy + fmt clean.

title: Cover revoked-token rejection in auth tests
acceptance: Test creates a token with revoked_at set and asserts 401
Test runs only when AME_RUN_DB_TESTS=1
notes: Standalone tokio::test revoked_token_returns_unauthorized inserts api_tokens row with revoked_at=now() and valid secret hash, asserts 401. Same AME_RUN_DB_TESTS=1 gate as the omnibus test. Runs against a fresh user_id/token_id so the existing test isn't disturbed.

title: Document idempotency semantics + production wiring TODO
acceptance: Doc comments record the 2xx-only store policy and auth-before-replay invariant
router() carries a TODO pointing to Plan 3 where the middleware lands on POST routes
notes: Module-level rustdoc on idempotency.rs enumerates all five header/auth/state combinations; router() rustdoc points to Plan 3 for middleware attachment and notes /healthz stays outside any layer.

title: Remove dead ApiToken struct
acceptance: domain/user.rs no longer defines unused ApiToken
cargo check passes
notes: Confirmed no source references via grep; removed. Plan 3+ token-issuance code can reintroduce a tailored type when the exact field needs are known.

title: Add points and objectives columns (questions/quizzes/exams)
acceptance: questions.points int default 1 (spec §4.5)
quizzes.objectives text[] default '{}' (spec §4.6)
exams.objectives text[] default '{}' (spec §4.7)
Backfill rule documented per spec §13
notes: Schema-only delta required before P3 quiz authoring and P8 share work can land. Surfaces as soft-warn at >6 objectives per §5.2.

title: Add share_links and anonymous_attempts tables
acceptance: share_links table with created_by_user_id, kind, target_id, visibility, include_explanation/score/attribution, revoked_at, og_image_url (spec §4.16, §5.3)
anonymous_attempts table for embed ?interactive=1 path (spec §5.2 rate limit)
Indexes from §5.3 present
CHECK constraint on share_links.visibility enum
notes: Prerequisite migration for P8 share surface. Anonymous-attempt rows never linked to a user.
